title: Disabling and re-enabling of UE's N1 mode capability for 3GPP access

entities.name: N1 mode capability for 3GPP access
entities.description: UE's capability to operate in N1 mode over 3GPP access. Can be disabled and re-enabled under various conditions.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5GMM idle state where UE can disable N1 mode capability.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: State entered when UE cannot find suitable cell and performs PLMN selection.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: State entered when UE has no registered PLMN and performs PLMN selection.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: State entered during redirection to EPC when no suitable cell found.

entities.name: PLMN selection
entities.description: Procedure to select a PLMN when N1 mode is disabled.

entities.name: SNPN selection
entities.description: Procedure to select an SNPN when N1 mode is disabled.

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure that may prevent re-enabling of N1 mode capability.

entities.name: UE network capability IE
entities.description: Information element containing N1mode bit indicating N1 mode support.

entities.name: Implementation-specific timer
entities.description: Timer started during redirection to EPC when no suitable cell found.

entities.name: Redirection to EPC required
entities.description: Condition triggered by cause value #31 requiring N1 mode disable.

entities.name: No network slice available
entities.description: Condition where UE may disable N1 mode capability.

relations.description: N1 mode capability can only be disabled when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
PLMN selection procedure requires entering PLMN-SEARCH state.
SNPN selection procedure requires entering PLMN-SEARCH state.
Redirection to EPC condition establishes LIMITED-SERVICE state.
Redirection to EPC condition starts implementation-specific timer.
Timer expiry establishes re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
UE network capability IE contains N1mode bit indicating N1 mode support status.
No network slice available condition establishes disabling of N1 mode capability.
UE-initiated de-registration procedure guards re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
